English.Char_Desc_2000:
Mole for Mac is a native system maintenance utility that keeps your Mac lean and fast. It safely cleans application and system caches, removes leftover files left behind by uninstalled apps, fully uninstalls programs you no longer need, and shows exactly where your disk space is going so you can reclaim it with confidence.
Mole pairs a free, open-source GPL-3.0 command-line interface with a polished paid GUI, giving both power users and everyday users a fast, reviewable way to maintain macOS.
Key features: - Clean application, browser, and system caches - Remove leftovers from uninstalled applications - Fully uninstall programs along with their residual files - Analyze disk usage and find large or forgotten files - Review actions before anything is removed
Download: https://mole.fit/Mole.dmg Product page: https://mole.fit Source code (CLI): https://github.com/tw93/Mole Contact: hi@mole.fit Location: Hong Kong
